description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.60 each), grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken White Magic], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Divine Will Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken White Magic
description.text: White Magic abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, White Magic abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Divine Will Mode
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, 50% chance for White Magic abilities to trigger 1 additional time
